sections.content: Eyebrow, H1, lead, search form (same API call and query param), notched photo tile

Count summary (aria-live), client-side chips (Verified only; country and degree only when the results hold more than one value), two-column card grid. Card fields are only those the API returns: degree, cycle, school, programme, city, country, application fee, round deadlines, verification status, official source link.

states.empty: No matching programs message, Show all programmes button
states.error: Catalogue unavailable, danger-tinted panel, Try again

notes: No route exists for starting a mock interview per programme, so no such link. Route-type filters (CAT, GMAT, executive) are not in the catalogue data, so not offered.
